newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CAMINERO MARKS RETURN WITH ATLETICO GOAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CAMINERO MARKS RETURN WITH ATLETICO GOAL.

text.p: Spanish international Jose Luis Caminero celebrated his return from injury with a well-taken goal as Atletico Madrid dispatched newly promoted Hercules 3-0 on Monday.
The result leaves Atletico in sixth position with nine points from five games, four behind leaders Barcelona.
Atletico went ahead after just three minutes when Toni Munoz blasted home a 30-metre left foot shot from a free kick that gave Hercules keeper Miguel Mari no chance.
Mari seemed to be expecting a shot from right-footed set-piece specialist Milinko Pantic.

Delfi Geli made it 2-0 by heading home a superbly-weighted cross from Pantic ten minutes into the second half, and there was no way back for Hercules when Francisco Anton was sent off for hacking down Santiago Ezquerro shortly afterwards.
Pantic hit the post with a penalty awarded 15 minutes from the end after Carmelo Manresa had hacked down Argentine international striker Juan Eduardo Esnaider.
It was his second penalty miss of the league season.
Caminero, who was injured in Atletico's first league game, came on as substitute in the final ten minutes and rose well to head home a cross from Diego Simeone in the dying seconds.
Before the game Atletico coach Radomir Antic and club chairman Jesus Gil were presented with the league trophy won by the club for the ninth time in the summer.
